name: Drop Zone
design_intent:
THE GAUNTLET — level 5 (tier 2, a bigger single threat: a DEBRIS STORM). A symmetric flagship three-island arena over ONE full-width lethal void, pelted by a steady rain of lethal falling chunks across SIX spread columns (two over each island). Debris was only ever seen COMBINED before (hazard_yard); this is the solo, dialled-up read: 'the sky is falling -- watch the shadows and never stand still.' Reuses the shipped FallingDebris spawner -> a chunk overlap = kill(&ring_out) (NOT a shove); chunks despawn on landing with a dust puff. kill_shape = void_is_floor -> QA uses K1' (off-screen kills >= 88%).

DOCTRINE FIT (§2.0): (1) LETHAL -- a chunk overlap instakills via kill(&ring_out); no new impulse/hitstun. (2) TELEGRAPHY -- a growing ground shadow + a pulsing hazard-red reticle + a drop line mark each impact column for telegraph_lead 0.7s BEFORE the chunk exists; read it, step off. (3) FAIRNESS -- a steady cadence 1.0s with max_concurrent 3 (NEVER a wall of chunks filling all footing at once); the six columns are ~450px apart with the island tops (900px wide) leaving wide gaps between them, so a safe standing spot always exists each beat; symmetric (any player under a marked column faces it equally). (4) CREDIT -- a chunk kill with no attacker = uncredited self-fall (killer=-1, INV-9); a rival knocked under a marked column within kill_credit_window_ringout=6.0s is credited by the existing ring-out window. No environment scorer.

GEOMETRY (symmetric flagship void_is_floor, mirrors hammer_arena): three flat trampoline islands over ONE full-width void: A x0..900 / B x1580..2480 / C x3160..4060, all top y1080, separated by 680px void gaps. SIX debris columns, two per island at the island quarters: A [225, 675] / B [1805, 2255] / C [3385, 3835] -- round-robined so the storm sweeps evenly, ~450px apart so the mid-column and island-edge bands are always safe to stand. Chunks drop from spawn_y 200 at fall_speed 1400, radius 60, and despawn on floor_y 1080 (the island tops). Bounds -610..4670 x, top -2090, bottom 1878 (>= 650px recovery sky). VOID READS AS DEATH via pit_void_rendering (dark gradient + canyon walls + under-lip AO + hazard-red rim/chevrons + falling motes).

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP (flight-required; Tuning: trampoline apex 270px => ~395px zero-boost drift; spring apex 480 => ~527px max spring drift; normal_boost_max 760 crosses 680px in ~0.9-1.0s):
- GAP A<->B (island edges x900..x1580 = 680px over void): > 527 and >> 395. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; miss = fall into the void. Verb: FLY.
- GAP B<->C (x2480..x3160 = 680px over void): identical. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- DODGE the storm: step off a column during its 0.7s telegraph; with max_concurrent 3 and six spread columns, the gaps between columns (and the island edges) are always safe -- never a full-footing wall. Verb: DODGE (+ READ). The debris never makes a required GAP crossing uncrossable (chunks fall on the island tops, not into the crossing lane) and never creates a bounce path across a gap.
- Zero-boost off any island reaches NO other surface across a 680px gap: flight is REQUIRED; the debris reshapes/times the on-island fight, it never carries you across.

SIGNATURE / DISTINCT: the first SOLO falling-debris level and the densest debris read in the circuit (hazard_yard drips 3 columns as a side-threat; this is a 6-column storm you dance under). One-sentence C3 read: 'never stand still -- read the falling shadows and shove rivals under a chunk or off into the pit.'
